text: Implemented NeuralInput.either and reg.neuralInputEither with typed refusals before sample conversion/allocation. Restoring the old unchecked count causes the existing just-over-budget regression to fail on both platforms; mutant allocated only 1,000,002 samples per array. Source restored and selector removed.
